exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "whether or if".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～かどうか matches "whether or if".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～かどうか.
exercises.explanation: Used to express uncertainty or indirect questions with "whether" or "if".
